visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long black hair, dressed in a pink and white fuzzy cardigan over a black top and dark skirt, sits on the tiled steps of an indoor staircase. She holds a silver smartphone in her left hand and a specialized black microphone with a digital display in her right. Her expression is focused and sentimental as she lip-syncs to a song, looking down at her phone. The background consists of a plain off-white wall with visible textures and a dark baseboard along the stairs. (2) A transition effect featuring a bright white flash occurs, shifting the scene slightly. The woman remains in the same seated position, continuing her emotional performance. She sways her body gently to the rhythm of the music while maintaining her grip on the microphone and phone. The lighting is bright and uniform, creating a clean, indoor studio-like atmosphere despite the simple setting.
